senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. צרר)to turn, shape, form.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 8a:3">Keth. 8ᵃ</cite> (marriage benediction) <he>אשר י׳ את וכ׳</he> who hast formed man in thine image.

<cite ref="Berakhot 58b:5">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> (prayer in a burial place) <he>אשר י׳ אתכם וכ׳</he> who created you in justice &c.; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="J00228"><he>יוֹצֵר</he></cite> (as noun, v. <cite ref="J00228"><he>יוֹצֵר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Berakhot 11b:1">Ib. 11ᵇ</cite> (in the morning prayer) <he>י׳ אור בורא וכ׳</he> who didst form light and create darkness.—<he>יוֹצֵר אוֹר</he> or <cite ref="J00228"><he>יוֹצֵר</he></cite> name of one of the benedictions preceding the reading of the morning Sh’ma.

senses.gloss: to be formed, created; to be fully developed.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:3">Gen. R. s. 9</cite> <he>קודם עד שלא נוֹצְרָה מחשבה וכ׳</he> ere yet a thought is formed in the heart of man &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:7">Ib.</cite> <he>קודם … נ׳ יצור</he>, v. <cite ref="J00537"><he>יְצִיר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:8">Ab. II, 8</cite> <he>לכך נוֹצָרְתָּ</he> for that purpose (of studying) thou hast been created.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:4">Gen. R. s. 14</cite>, beg.; Y. Yeb. IV, 5ᵈ top <he>נ׳ לשבעה</he> if the embryo was fully developed at seven months, contrad. to <he>נולד</he>, v. <cite ref="J00367"><he>יָלַד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 85a">Yoma 85ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 45b:16">Sot. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>מהיכן הוולד נ׳</he> from where does the formation of the embryo start?; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="R00242"><he>צוּר</he></cite>.
